preview.en: Room’s ready whenever you land. Text when you’re on the train.
preview.hr: Soba je spremna kad god stigneš. Javi kad budeš u vlaku.

text.en: Everything’s arranged at the institute. Season staff housing, starts whenever you’re ready.
text.hr: Sve je dogovoreno na institutu. Sezonski smještaj za osoblje, počinje kad god budeš spremna.

text.en: Please don’t tell my dad you helped.
text.hr: Molim te, ne reci tati da si mi pomogao.

text.en: He already knows. He asked me to.
text.hr: On već zna. On me zamolio.

text.en: I can’t believe you’d say that to me.

Fine. Whatever. I’m not speaking to you again.

hints.en: She wasn't hiding the fight — half the school knew about that.
hints.hr: Nije skrivala svađu — pola škole je za nju znalo.

hints.en: 'F' was never a predator. He was help she was too scared to accept in person.
hints.hr: 'F' nikad nije bio grabežljivac. Bio je pomoć koju se previše bojala prihvatiti uživo.

hints.en: The hidden thread is 'F' — the marine-institute contact quietly arranging her season place by the sea.
hints.hr: Skriveni razgovor je 'F' — kontakt s morskog instituta koji joj je tiho slagao sezonsko mjesto kraj mora.
